integrity: The theorem follows from analytic monotonicity of the inradius, circumradius and weighted inradius, and an exactly one-crossing sign argument. Numerical diagnostics are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Only concentric radial distances from area-uniform points in equal-area regular polygons with integer side counts at least three; the single-polygon CDF and disk endpoint are prior work, and global historical priority is not independently established.
title: One-crossing stochastic ordering of centered radial distances in equal-area regular polygons
